newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks post second straight record close.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks post second straight record close.

* Toronto's key stock index jumped to a second straight record high close on Friday, also breaking the old all-time high.* Anticipation of strong Q2 earnings boosted market.
Toronto's key stock index posted its second straight record high close on Friday, rallying in expectation of improved quarterly profits in the upcoming reporting season.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index jumped 33.48 points to 6626.40, also breaking the all-time intraday high.
Turnover was healthy at 95 million shares worth C$1.5 billion.
"The market is anticipating better second-quarter earnings," said Montreal-based portfolio manager Ron Meisels.
Second-quarter earnings results have begun to trickle in.
Investors were also bargain hunting in Toronto's battered gold sector, Meisels said, spurring modest gains in one of its most heavily weighted groups.
The transportation sector led nine of Toronto's 14 sub-indexes higher, followed by golds, industrial products, media and forestry products.
The weaker side included oils and base metals.
Canada's largest equities market reached a new intraday record of 6633 points, capping a week of gains. The 300 index rose 64 points this week from Monday's open of 6526.
Advancing issues outnumbered declines 564 to 391, while 300 traded flat.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* Shares in Geac Computer Corp Ltd soared 9.50 to 47.50 in brisk dealings. It posted fourth-quarter earnings of C$0.70 per share, up 131 percent from last year's C$0.31 a share.
* Influential Barrick Gold Corp gained 0.60 to 30.55, continuing to rebound from weakness earlier this week as gold bullion prices fell to 12-year lows.
* Elan Energy Inc dropped 1.25 to a 52-week low of 8 on almost 3.4 million shares after an analyst reported a gloomy outlook for the oil company's production, financial and stock performance.
((Lydia Zajc, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8109))
